module accumulator_core #(
    parameter WIDTH = 8
)(
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    input wire sample_valid,
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] sample,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] sum,
    output wire sample_ready
);
    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            sum <= 0;
        end else begin
            if (sample_valid) begin
                sum <= sum + sample;
            end
        end
    end

    assign sample_ready = 1'b1;
endmodule

        .out_valid(out0_valid),
        .out_ready(out0_ready),
        .out_data(out0_data)
    );

    stream_stage #(.WIDTH(8)) u_stage1 (
        .clk(clk),
        .rst_n(rst_n),
        .in_valid(fork_out1_valid),
        .in_ready(fork_out1_ready),
        .in_data(fork_out1_data),
        .out_valid(out1_valid),
        .out_ready(out1_ready),
        .out_data(out1_data)
    );

endmodule

module accumulator_core (
    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    input sample_valid,
    input [7:0] sample,
    output reg sample_ready,
    output reg [7:0] sum
);

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            sum <= 8'd0;
            sample_ready <= 1'b1;
        end else begin
            if (sample_valid & sample_ready) begin
                sum <= sum + sample;
            end
            sample_ready <= 1'b1; // always ready
        end
    end

endmodule
